system.description:
You knead your own flesh like a sculptor working clay, recasting your face, voice, skin tone and build into a new form — or a hideous one.

Spend one Blood Trait and take time reshaping yourself. Cosmetic self-alterations succeed automatically. To copy a specific person you must win a Static Mental Challenge at a difficulty equal to the subject's Social Traits; even when disguised you still use your own Social Traits in challenges, merely wearing the other's appearance. You may instead disfigure yourself, taking on up to three Repugnant Negative Traits.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
